name: slate
description: SLATE - an actor and actress life simulator

scripts.validate: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test
scripts.gate: npm run validate && node tools/title-case.mjs --check && node tools/label-sweep.mjs && node tools/plural-check.mjs && node tools/voice-check.mjs --check && node tools/tics.mjs --check && node tools/doc-refs.mjs --check && node tools/wired.mjs --check && node tools/deciders.mjs --check && node tools/spelling.mjs && node tools/typos.mjs && npx vite-node tools/geo-check.mjs && node tools/inventory.mjs --check
scripts.base44:deploy: npm run build && npx --yes @base44/cli deploy --config base44/config.jsonc
